title: My Brief: Wednesday, October 28
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Wednesday brief. Here is what matters today, from Egypt, Bayern, Germany, and the global markets. First, Egypt. The pound has hit a fresh record low. On Monday it weakened past fifty-six to the dollar for the first time, after touching about fifty-five on Thursday last week. Reports say foreign and Arab investors sold roughly six hundred and sixty million dollars …

title: Test episode: your new voice
description: Good morning, and welcome to your Sunday brief. This is a quick test, so you can hear how I sound before we switch the real briefs over. Bayern had a solid week, markets were a little nervous, and back home in Cairo the weather is finally cooling down. If this sounds like you, we're in business. If not, tell me what feels off, and I'll tune it.
